text: dsh-usage-cost 是面向 DSH Web 的 Token 用量与费用监控插件。它读取 DSH 会话持久化服务中的会话事件，按模型汇总输入、缓存命中与未命中、输出、推理 Token 和调用次数，并依据模型单价估算费用。插件在设置侧栏加入“用量与费用”面板，可按全部、当天、近一天、近一周或近一个月筛选，查看 USD 与人民币估值、缓存命中率和模型明细；价格可按模型覆盖并保存，另支持自动刷新。计价使用 DeepSeek 官方定价与 USD/CNY 汇率服务，并有内置价格回退；不需要 API Key。

dsh-usage-cost summarizes DSH token use and estimated model costs by session and model. Its Settings panel shows USD/CNY estimates, filters by time period, and saves price overrides. It uses public pricing and exchange-rate services with built-in price fallbacks; no API key is needed.

dsh-usage-cost 的功能「跨会话用量面板」：读取 DSH 会话事件，按模型汇总 Token、调用次数和估算费用。打开设置中的“用量与费用”栏目，可筛选时间范围并查看 USD/CNY 金额。
dsh-usage-cost 的功能「模型价格管理」：面板显示每个模型的缓存命中、未命中和输出单价，并允许编辑、保存或删除自定义价格。插件将覆盖价格保存到 usage-cost 设置命名空间；缺少远程定价时可使用内置价格表。
dsh-usage-cost 使用前须知：插件会向 api-docs.deepseek.com 请求模型定价，并向 open.er-api.com 请求 USD/CNY 汇率；这些请求用于获取公开数据，代码中未见随请求发送会话用量数据。

Token usage & cost monitor for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Aggregates token usage across all session logs, computes per-model cost (USD / approx. RMB), and renders a native panel inside Settings — no URL hunting needed.

dsh-usage-cost README · Features：- **Cross-session aggregation** — scans every session log via `ctx.sessionPersistence`, tallies per-model input (cache-miss / cache-hit), output, reasoning tokens and call counts.
- **Cost calculation** — official DeepSeek pricing page (with built-in fallback table) × usage → cost; live USD→CNY exchange rate.
- **Editable prices** — per-model price overrides right in the panel (persisted via settings); every row has save/delete icon buttons.
- **Time windows** — all / last 24h / today / last 7d / last 30d.
- **Auto-refresh** — selectable interval: off / 1m / 5m / 30m / 1h / 12h (background silent refresh, never blocks).
- **Hit-rate color grading** — <60% red · 60–80% yellow · ≥80% green.
- **Localized** — the panel follows DSH's own UI language (Chinese / English), no separate switch.
- **Instant reopen** — data cached at module level, reopening Settings shows content immediately.

dsh-usage-cost README · Metrics：Six summary cards on top of the panel:

| Card | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Total (USD) | Billed cost of all calls in USD |
| Total (≈CNY) | USD × live exchange rate |
| Total tokens | Input + cache-hit + cache-miss + output + reasoning |
| Sessions / Calls | Sessions with usage / total call count |
| Avg token price | Total cost (CNY) ÷ total tokens per 1M (¥/M) |
| Reasoning share | Reasoning ÷ (output + reasoning), share of thinking |
dsh-usage-cost README · Metrics：Billing formula: `miss = input-miss + cache-write`; `hit = cache-read`; `out = output + reasoning`; `cost = miss×miss-price + hit×hit-price + out×out-price`.
